name: The materials: what already exists that could fill a goal
description: search the collections for parts that could fill each slot of a goal, rank them by the confidence each source declares about itself, flag the n best bets, and keep apart the three different things that otherwise all read as 'nothing found'
phrases: what do we already have that could do this
which plasmids could fill this slot
rank the candidates for a promoter
what should I go and look for in the freezer
why did the search find nothing

data.scope: Phase 1b of experimental planning: what already exists that could fill each slot of a goal, where it is, and how much each hit can be trusted. It ranks and shortlists. It is NOT the goal — what must be true of the construct names no plasmid and no box, and is phase 1a. It is NOT the design: deciding what to synthesise from what was found is phase 2. It does NOT own the collections — the plasmids, boxes and sequence libraries live in the project repositories that mount this world, and a source is whatever one of them hands over. It does NOT decide that something is absent, and it does NOT rank by anything it worked out for itself about a collection.
invariants: IT RANKS AND NEVER EXCLUDES. JCA, 2026-11-04: 'when planning, I don't think it should try to exclude. It should give all the options and provide its n best bets for the experimentalist to look for and find a sample of. Let the user pick which to go after.' `best` is a recommendation sitting on top of the full list, never a filter applied to it, and a search that dropped its low-confidence hits would be deciding on the experimentalist's behalf with a model it cannot justify about a freezer it has never opened.

CONFIDENCE IS DECLARED BY THE SOURCE AND CARRIED THROUGH UNCHANGED. `jtk.find` reporting a -80 hit as a tube you can walk to and a plasmid-stock hit as a lead is right FOR THAT COLLECTION and does not generalise — JCA, 2026-11-04: 'those -80 things are correctly addressed and present. The plasmids and other tabs of this, less clear if they exist.' Some boxes are better than others and nothing here is in a position to know which.

THREE KINDS OF NOTHING ARE KEPT APART, because each wants a different action: a slot type nothing can fill (`unfilled` — go and find a part, or loosen the goal), a source that could not be read (`unreadable`, by name and reason — the answer may be in there and nobody looked), and the sources that did answer (`read` — so a thin result can be weighed against how little was searched). A result reporting no candidates from one unreachable mount is not a finding about the freezer.

THE ONLY JUDGEMENT MADE IS THAT A PART WITH A SEQUENCE OUTRANKS ONE WITHOUT, at equal confidence, because one can be designed against today and the other has to be fetched first. It is worth a quarter of a point, it is stated in every candidate's `why`, and anything cleverer would be this toolkit forming an opinion about a collection it has never seen.

A MISS IS WEAK EVIDENCE WHEN A COLLECTION IS OLD. The JTK collection's dates run 2010-2012, so pDel7, pGhost and pBACr899 are all real and all absent from it. 'Not in this collection' and 'does not exist' are different sentences, and a source that knows its own horizon should say so in its label.

branches.name: one slot
branches.what: every candidate for a single slot, best first, with why. `materials.rankcandidates`

branches.name: a whole goal
branches.what: every slot of every device, plus what could not be filled and what could not be read. `materials.materialsforgoal`

branches.name: the gate
branches.what: phase 1b is passed when `unfilled` is empty and `unreadable` is empty or deliberately accepted

branches.name: what is NOT here
branches.what: no adapter yet turns a mounted world's collection into a source — `jtk.find` (Nissle), `pimar.plasmid.promoter-map` (Pimar) and `igem-deletion.parts` are three different searches keyed to three different things, and none of them takes a goal

notes: WRITTEN 2026-11-04. WHAT IS MISSING IS THE ADAPTERS, and this skill should not be read as though phase 1b were closed. C6 now owns the ranking and the absence bookkeeping; what no code does yet is turn a particular world's collection into the `Source` shape this takes. Until one does, a caller supplies sources by hand and the gate is only as good as what was handed to it.
